description: Voiries - Tours Métropole Val de Loire is a dataset listed in opendataTMVL open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Tours Métropole Val de Loire. Données géographique linéaire, une voie est un emplacement localisé et dénommé par un arrêté municipal. A NOTER: Les données sont en cours de mise à jour. Coverage: Tours Métropole Val de Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité, Référenciels. Its keywords are voirie, mobilité. The portal shows 36,178 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-04-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-tours-metropole-fr-portal.
